marks.gloss_en: תניא כמאן דאמר אף אהרן נצטרע -- 'and Aaron turned to Miriam': he turned from his own leprosy
ואלא הכתיב 'בם'! -- but the verse says 'against THEM', both of them; how can R' Yehuda ben Beteira say 'and if not'?
ההוא בנזיפה בעלמא -- that anger was a mere rebuke, not leprosy (= p_bam_binzifa)
that ['against them'] was a mere rebuke
ואלא הא גמר גזירה שוה! -- but R' Akiva derived it by a gezera shava; how can R' Yehuda ben Beteira say 'and if not'?
גזירה שוה לא גמר -- R' Yehuda ben Beteira had not received the gezera shava (see epistemic:)
then from what was he [i.e. what was Zelophehad's sin]? he was of those who 'presumed to ascend' (Num 14:44)
'and the anger of the Lord burned against them, and He went' (Num 12:9) teaches that Aaron too became leprous
one who suspects the innocent is afflicted in his body
believers -- as it is written 'and the people believed' (Ex 4:31)
מדקאמר ברשות הרבים עצמה -- 'the public domain itself' is below ten, so there they dispute
the baraita: from a private domain to a private domain, passing through the public domain itself -- R' Akiva holds him liable
והאי דקתני רשות הרבים עצמה -- להודיעך כחן דרבנן: the word teaches the Rabbis' strength, not where R' Akiva's liability ends (the stam: ופליגא דרבי אלעזר)
R' Elazar: R' Akiva holds him liable even [where it passed] above ten handbreadths
תניא נמי הכי: בתוך שלשה דברי הכל חייב
תניא נמי הכי: למעלה מעשרה אינו אלא משום שבות
תניא נמי הכי: משלשה ועד עשרה רבי עקיבא מחייב וחכמים פוטרין
the baraita: within three -- all agree he is liable
אי הכי, שלשה נמי? -- if the ground's unevenness is the reason, three handbreadths should count as joined too
ותו, הא דתנן: the sukka walls let down less than three above the ground are valid -- and there the public domain's unevenness has no place
the sukka mishna: one who lets the walls down from above -- if they are three handbreadths above the ground, [the sukka] is invalid (by inference: less than three, valid)
התם היינו טעמא: a partition goats can pass through [is no partition] (= p_gdayim_bokin)
תינח למטה, למעלה מאי איכא למימר? -- that works below, near the ground; what can be said of lavud above? (it attacks the goats answer's reach as well; see header)
there the reason is that it is a partition through which goats pass
ולאו מי אוקימנא: Rav speaks of one house high and one low -- sometimes it falls and he comes to fetch it (= p_okimta_midalei)
Rav: two houses on two sides of the public domain -- it is forbidden to throw from one to the other
למטה מעשרה הוא דמחייב, למעלה מעשרה לא מחייב? והאמר רבי אלעזר: המוציא משאוי למעלה מעשרה חייב, שכן משא בני קהת
(candidate) the baraita speaks of passing an object by hand
side 1: they dispute below ten handbreadths, over whether an object in the airspace counts as set down; above ten all agree he is exempt, and we do not derive throwing from passing
side 2: they dispute above ten, over whether throwing is derived from passing; below ten all agree he is liable, for an object in the airspace counts as set down
Rav Chilkiya bar Tovi: within three handbreadths [of the ground] -- all agree he is liable
anything less than three [handbreadths apart] is as if joined (lavud)
the baraita: from the public domain to the public domain with a private domain between -- Rabbi holds him liable
the measure of good comes more quickly than the measure of punishment
'and Aaron's staff swallowed their staffs' (Ex 7:12) -- a miracle within a miracle
